title: Identify European Soil indexed source words
changes: Authenticate the original e3838 reader sequence, root and 30 observed indexed source words without imposing a new guest index bound.
validation: Wine disassembly e268-soil-e3838-disassembly-wine-l8md6ii5 and protected static plan e268-soil-e3838-source-plan-dvwif_zm verify the signed RAM index, base 14d580, existing root literal and 30 sampled words/120 bytes at observed indices 1 through 32.
limitations: No complete index domain or guard is established; preserve raw fallback for unselected and negative indices. Scopes may contain nested accesses and the plan publishes no owner.
Index writers, other consumers, scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance comparison was performed.
